summary: JSON CLI with local home/environment profiles, temporary authenticated HTTPS host leases, plugin management, bank synchronization, OS scheduling and optional remote HTTPS profiles.

operations.name: interface
operations.summary: Provide the declared cli interface or remote authority adapter.

output.description: The operation result in the enclosing response data field.

operations.side_effects: The interface delegates explicit reads/mutations to public services; it does not define financial rules.
operations.permissions: Host-scoped SDK access; this callback is not remotely callable.
operations.scope: Host-supplied budget/environment context and personal/demo workspace where the method accepts it. Credentials remain machine-local.
errors: Invalid or unsupported input is rejected without applying a new decision.
Unavailable feature/storage returns an authored error; stale revisions and reused request IDs with different intent conflict.
operations.retry: Read again as needed; reads never authorize a later write using an old revision.
operations.availability: SDK callback only; consult the owning README for the typed in-process contract.

operations.name: status

output.description: Action-specific local response; secrets are never returned.

operations.permissions: Local authority access with HTTPS and Host/origin checks. Not exposed by the remote ledger API.
operations.scope: Explicit budget and personal/demo workspace; currencies are never combined.
errors: Invalid or unsupported input is rejected without applying a new decision.
Unavailable feature/storage returns an authored error; stale revisions and reused request IDs with different intent conflict.
operations.retry: Inspect local state after an uncertain mutation. Paid inference is never automatically retried.

operations.name: plugins
operations.summary: List/status or enable/disable installed plugins through the authenticated local host.

plugin.description: CLI plugin identifier, such as ynab-zip-importer; required for enable/disable. The YNAB CLI identifier preserves its existing host and saved-budget identity.

input.description: Explicit local CLI arguments. The connection profile supplies home, budget and environment.

output.description: JSON host/plugin/job projection or operation result.

operations.side_effects: Enable/disable applies supported live transitions and browser drains. Restart-required preflight saves a validated startup selection and returns restart_required: true; running plugins remain active until restart. List/status only reads metadata.
operations.permissions: Authenticated device-local CLI profile with home and explicit sandbox/production environment. Personal workspace only; not available through remote profiles.
operations.scope: Selected runtime home, permanent budget identity and environment. Credentials remain machine-local.
errors: Unavailable plugins, invalid selections, busy work and failed live transitions are rejected. Restart-required plugin selection is saved for the next startup.
Startup, TLS, authorization, storage or recovery failures return sanitized errors.
operations.retry: Never automatically replay failed commands. Inspect status and native recovery before explicitly retrying an uncertain operation.
operations.availability: Local CLI command with an explicit home profile; not remotely callable. See whab-cli COMMAND --help.

operations.name: sync
operations.summary: Synchronize existing bank connections immediately through the local host.

plugin.description: Enabled bank plugin ID, for example plaid.

input.description: Explicit local CLI arguments. The connection profile supplies home, budget and environment.

output.description: JSON host/plugin/job projection or operation result.

operations.side_effects: Calls the existing provider coordinator and atomically saves transaction changes/cursors. Does not create a connection or force institution refresh.

operations.summary: Inspect due-job status, run due jobs, or register/remove hourly OS wakeups.

input.description: Explicit local CLI arguments. The connection profile supplies home, budget and environment.

output.description: JSON host/plugin/job projection or operation result.

operations.side_effects: status reads private sanitized job status; run executes only due work; enable/disable changes a private macOS LaunchAgent. A running host retains enabled provider intervals.
